alcohol.answer: Etihad lists alcoholic beverages above 70% alcohol by volume as not permitted in cabin or checked baggage. The page read gives no quantity limit for drinks at or below 70%.

sections.p: From the Etihad page "Prohibited items and what you can take on board", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Etihad rule
rows: Not permitted in cabin or checked baggage
Flammable liquids such as alcohol or ethanol (fuel, thinner)
Not permitted in cabin or checked baggage
No quantity limit is stated on this page

list: Not on the page: a litre limit, a rule for duty-free bottles and a rule for drinking your own alcohol are not on this page. Check the Conditions of Carriage and Etihad before you fly.

faq: What alcohol is banned on Etihad flights?
Etihad does not permit alcoholic beverages above 70% alcohol by volume in cabin or checked baggage.
Does Etihad give a litre limit for alcohol?
Not on its Prohibited items page, so ask Etihad or check its Conditions of Carriage.
